title: InngestRun
description: A function run on the Inngest platform. Represents one durable execution of a function for a given trigger event, including step-level state and outputs.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for the function run.

function_id.description: Identifier of the deployed function being executed.

app_id.description: Identifier of the Inngest app that owns the function.

event_id.description: Identifier of the event that triggered the run.

output.description: Final output emitted by the function on completion.
